title: Assessment of Transboundary Haze Episodes, and Review of Bilateral and Regional Haze-mitigation Measures
what_it_is: Assessment of Transboundary Haze Episodes, and Review of Bilateral and Regional Haze-mitigation Measures

sections.label: Hotspot activity could increase
sections.summary: The Meteorological Service Singapore assessed that hotspot activity could increase in coming weeks over nearby areas due to wind patterns and drier conditions in the northeast monsoon's dry phase.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Meteorological Service Singapore has assessed that hotspot activity could increase in the coming weeks over nearby areas due to wind patterns and drier conditions in the current dry phase of the northeast monsoon.

sections.label: PSI readings and haze measures
sections.summary: 24-hour PSI readings stayed good to moderate this year with a peak of 69 on 8 February, so the haze has not warranted investigation under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Our 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index (PSI) readings have remained in the "good" to "moderate" range this year, with a peak PSI reading of 69 on 8 February, well within the "moderate" range.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Hence, at this stage, the haze has not reached such levels that warrant investigation under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Should the haze situation worsens, the Haze Task Force (HTF), led by the National Environment Agency (NEA) and comprising 28 Government agencies, will implement measures to safeguard public health, particularly for vulnerable populations, such as the elderly, pregnant women, children and people with chronic lung and heart diseases.

sections.label: Domestic regulations and preparedness responses
sections.summary: The speaker shares concern for Singaporeans' well-being and cites domestic regulations like the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act and a scientifically-based hierarchy of responses ready to activate.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I do share the Member's concern for Singaporeans' well-being and indeed, that has been an issue for us to pay significant attention to, both in terms of getting our own domestic regulations in place, such as the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act, as well as to work very closely with our own agencies for preparedness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We do not wish it to recur, but if it does, we believe that we have developed a scientifically-based hierarchy of responses, catering to different segments of the society and we stand ready to activate them.

sections.label: No financial assistance from Singapore
sections.summary: They have capabilities and are aware of their own accountability to their people, so there is no discussion about financial assistance from Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: They have capabilities and they are aware of their own accountability to their people.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, there is no discussion about financial assistance from Singapore.

sections.label: Four companies under investigation
sections.summary: An investigation is open at this moment, with four companies under investigation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The second supplementary question, we have an investigation that is open at this moment, with four companies under investigation.

sections.label: Threshold not reached, monitoring closely
sections.summary: The threshold for a haze pollution episode has not been reached, but monitoring continues and plans will be activated if close to that threshold.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As I have explained earlier in my reply and also in my reply to the supplementary questions, we have not reached the threshold for a haze pollution episode.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: But we are monitoring closely and if we get close to that threshold, we will activate the plans.
